about: Statements typed by hand from public sources on rendezvous in low Earth orbit, one statement per source per pair of objects. Each gives what the source states of the stages the detector raises: plane (the chaser within a fraction of a degree of the target's plane, by launch or by manoeuvre), height (the semi-major axes matched), beside (the chaser holding near the target), closest (the nearest pass, in kilometres) and left (the chaser moving away). A window is a UTC day range, from and to inclusive, with the precision the source gives. Every statement cites where it was read and the day it was published. Never derived by a program.
